generation_cases.description: Unchanged polls do not churn an armed epoch or its repeating monitor.
Mutable accepted offsets do not participate in generation identity.
Selection digest is over persisted raw bytes, not a reordered representation.
Readiness is first-launch-safe and replacement classification is closed.

callback_cases.description: Physically impossible early earned-time callbacks reject before every effect.
A delayed physically possible callback accepts using the default 30-second jitter.
Accepted callback progress survives ordinary polling without monitor churn.
A stale canonical-day callback rejects before every effect.
Callback and retry identity are firewalled to their owning child device.

gate_cases.description: Canonical midnight retires yesterday and creates one new epoch without replacing a repeating monitor.
Pause/resume discards only a bucket crossing the boundary and accepts the first fully post-resume bucket.
A task bypass enables only its canonical date.
Reflection pause takes precedence over task bypass.
Device and canonical time zones are distinct rollover authorities.
Changing canonical time zone replaces once, rejects old callbacks, and does not migrate dated bypass markers.

ledger_cases.description: Earned time is attributed to the accepting device without sibling mutation.
A device cap reaches zero only for the capped device and enforcement set.
Shared exhaustion fans out earned shields and receipts to both devices with their own enforcement sets.
Per-app exhaustion mutates only the exact app-limit rule, app, and device.

manual_cases.description: Manual lock and unlock mutate only manual state and preserve metering bytes exactly.

protocol_cases.description: Version-1 requests remain accepted through compatibility before the device ratchets.
Version-1 requests are terminal drops after the device ratchets to version 2.

per_app_ordering_cases.description: Per-app set and clear commands are monotonic by ordering token, including equal-token idempotency.

phase3_cases.description: A ready horizon installs exactly today plus seven dated routes and does not churn across unchanged polls.
An expired horizon rejects an uncovered callback with zero metering effects and preserves unrelated lock sources.
excessiveActivities preserves verified routes, stops filling at the actual ready-through date, and never destructively replaces the last route.
Route, event, lifecycle, tombstone, and registration-pending rejection paths have zero effects.
A pending start has one durable app/DAM lease winner, one start, and exact-ID crash recovery.

observations.assertion: one winner and one physical start

phase3_cases.description: Shield, identity-cleanup, and rollover envelopes recover exact IDs without admitting old-owner effects.

observations.assertion: identity and rollover envelopes are owner-fenced

phase3_cases.description: A real v1 sample, registration, activation, v2 sample, and stale v1 retry traverse FastAPI routes and converge the durable rows once.

observations.assertion: v1 and v2 are one monotonic ledger

phase3_cases.description: The real taskPause shield source participates in the CAS contract and a mismatch preserves the complete current record.
A one-shot authoritative-base 409 uses a fresh corrected epoch and route while the prior route remains countable through dualV2 and cutoverReady.

observations.assertion: prior route drains before corrected cutover

phase3_cases.description: App and DAM use one 60-second install claim, and a post-crash loser adopts the exact daemon installation only after expiry.
Retry deadlines are exact and due work is globally ordered by deadline then durable work ID.

observations.assertion: all seven work priorities and install ties sort by the full due tuple

phase3_cases.description: A route tombstone is retained until all references terminate, stop is acknowledged, and the later retention deadline passes.

observations.assertion: retention uses the later exact deadline

phase3_cases.description: A DAM earned-envelope write survives an unrelated live-app mutation and a CAS conflict without dropping any source.

observations.assertion: all source provenance survives both paths

phase3_cases.description: A gate-close race returns paused without local activation, then conservative resume creates another fresh epoch and route through the same drain barrier.

observations.assertion: closed gate never ratchets or activates locally

phase3_cases.description: Legacy active, pending, and retiring monitor provenance migrates exactly and remains functional until verified v2 activation.
The cross-stack V30 artifact contract names exactly five request bytes plus one manifest and carries the fixed scenario identity.

observations.assertion: five exact request hashes plus manifest
